page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries, with a centred letter heading "G." in the middle. Faint show-through from the reverse page is visible in the background and is left out. Running head "FU. GA." at top, page number 303 at top right. Final catchword "Garru-" at lower right.

main_text.p: Furor] Furiæ, Cic. Lymphatus, Plin. Lymphaticus error, Sen. Intemperiæ, Plaut.
Furtim] Furtivè ingressus possessionem, Vlp. Furacissimè, Apul.
Furtum] Detractio alieni, Cic. Furatrinæ artificium, Apul.
Futurum omne incertum] Multa cadunt inter calicem, extremaque labra. Nescis quid serus vesper vehat. Vid. Eventus incerti.
main_text.head: G.
main_text.p: Albula, avis] Chlorio. Chlorion, Plin. Vireo. Icterus. Luteus, luridus ales. Picus nidum suspendens, Plin.
Galea] Cassis, Mart. Cassida, Virg. Cassila, Fest.
Gallina] Pecus volatile. Gallinaceum genus. Gallinaceus grex, Col.
Gallopavus] Meleagris, Varr. Plin. Gallina Africana, Varr. Avis Lybica. Avis Numidica. Avis guttata, Mart. Pavo Indicus, Longol. Card. Ales ab Indis, Ovid. Æmulus pavi, Iul. Scal.

Gallus] Gallus gallinaceus, Cic. Gallinaceus, Plin. Maritus gallinarum, Iuv. Prænuncia lucis ales, Ovid. Avis lucis cristata, Mart. Pyctes. Gallinaceus. Gallinacei mares, Col. Canora avis. Nocturnus vigil. Familiæ excitator. Horologium vivum. Gallinacei gregis dux fidelis.
Gangræna] Cancer, Celf. Carcinoma, Suet. Cacoëthes. Phagedæna, Plin.
Garrire] Verba funditare, Plaut. Garriditare. Gargaridiare, Var. Oblatrare assanias, Apul. Friguttire, Fulgen. Blaterare, Fest. Argutari, Non.
Garrulitas] Multiloquium, Plaut. Loquacitas, Cic. Verbositas, Firm. Loquendi temeritas. Petulantia loquendi, Gell. Larga copia fandi, Virg. Sartago loquendi, Pers.
